title: M&A mismatches in information asymmetry and merger and acquisition performance
affiliations: Peking University - Institute of New Structural Economics (INSE), University College Dublin (UCD) - Michael Smurfit Graduate School of Business and University of Denver - Department of Management

detail.title: M&A mismatches in information asymmetry and merger and acquisition performance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Michael J. Brennan Irish Finance Working Paper Series Research Paper No. 12-5
publicationDetails.journalName: Michael J. Brennan Irish Finance Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the impact of ex-ante target and acquirer information asymmetry (IA) measures on the performance of the combined post-merger firm. We propose a novel IA mismatch hypothesis that M&A deal and external parties can utilize which applies to simultaneous mismatches between the target and acquirer IA measured before the merger offer. This hypothesis examines how mismatches reflect the characteristics of the deal parties, and its influence on short-and long-run performance. We show that a highT-lowA IA combination (high or opaque target; low or transparent acquirer) is economically and significantly positively related to different measures of future longrun performance, but the opposite IA mismatch of lowT-highA (low or transparent target; high or opaque acquirer) has a negative impact. We attribute the former mismatch to IA capturing private target information that only low IA acquirers are better able to leverage due to greater transparency and better access to private information. We find that high IA acquirers "bite of more than they can chew", and perform poorly in the long run, no matter what the IA level of the target is.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了并购前目标公司与收购方信息不对称（IA）不匹配对并购后公司绩效的影响。研究发现，高IA目标-低IA收购方组合（目标信息不透明，收购方透明）与长期绩效正相关，而低IA目标-高IA收购方组合（目标透明，收购方不透明）则与长期绩效负相关。
AI.research_question: 并购前目标公司与收购方的信息不对称（IA）不匹配如何影响并购后公司的短期和长期绩效？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注单方面的信息不对称，但并购交易涉及双方的信息不对称特征。理解目标与收购方之间的IA不匹配如何影响并购绩效，对交易设计和外部评估具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、并购绩效理论、信息不匹配假说。研究提出"IA不匹配假说"，强调并购双方信息不对称特征的相互作用对绩效的影响。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用并购前目标与收购方的信息不对称度量，分析不同IA组合（高T-低A、低T-高A等）与并购后公司短期和长期绩效的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 高IA目标-低IA收购方组合（目标不透明，收购方透明）与长期绩效显著正相关；2. 低IA目标-高IA收购方组合（目标透明，收购方不透明）与长期绩效负相关；3. 高IA收购方无论目标IA水平如何，长期表现都较差，表明其"贪多嚼不烂"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"IA不匹配假说"，扩展了信息不对称理论在并购研究中的应用，强调了并购双方信息特征的相互作用而非单方面特征的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为并购交易设计提供指导：建议收购方应选择信息不透明的目标，但自身需保持信息透明；同时警示高IA收购方在并购中面临的风险。为投资者和监管机构评估并购交易提供新视角。

title: Why Real-Time Delivery Platforms Fail Without Incentive Design Incentives, Not Visibility, Determine Platform Performance

detail.title: Why Real-Time Delivery Platforms Fail Without Incentive Design Incentives, Not Visibility, Determine Platform Performance

keywords: Incentive Design Platform Economics Real-Time Systems Delivery Platforms Behavioral Operations Logistics Optimization AI-Driven Operations Digital Infrastructure

detail.abstract:
Real-time delivery platforms have become central to modern logistics, healthcare, and on-demand services. These systems promise efficiency through live tracking, dynamic routing, and instantaneous dispatch. Yet despite widespread adoption of real-time visibility tools, many platforms continue to experience persistent failures, including missed service windows, workforce churn, rising costs, and inconsistent service reliability.

This paper argues that these failures are not primarily driven by insufficient data or technological limitations, but by misaligned incentive structures that distort participant behavior. Drawing on platform economics, behavioral operations, and incentive theory, the paper demonstrates why visibility alone cannot produce reliable outcomes.

The paper introduces a readiness- and feasibility-aware incentive framework that conditions evaluation and compensation on probabilistic task feasibility rather than rigid time-based thresholds. By treating incentives as a core architectural layer in real-time systems, this framework enables more stable, fair, and scalable platform performance under uncertainty.

This work contributes a conceptual systems-design perspective and outlines principles for integrating predictive modeling, incentive alignment, and behavioral feedback in large-scale operational platforms.

AI.tldr: 实时配送平台虽然采用实时追踪技术，但仍面临服务失败、人员流失等问题。本文认为问题根源在于激励结构错配而非技术限制，提出了基于任务可行性概率的激励框架，将激励作为系统核心架构层。
AI.research_question: 为什么实时配送平台在拥有实时可见性工具的情况下仍然持续出现服务失败、人员流失和成本上升等问题？如何通过激励结构设计来解决这些问题？
AI.motivation: 实时配送平台在现代物流、医疗和按需服务中变得至关重要，但尽管广泛采用实时可见性工具，许多平台仍持续经历服务失败、人员流失、成本上升和服务可靠性不一致等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济学、行为运营学和激励理论。论文认为问题根源在于激励结构错配扭曲了参与者行为，而非数据不足或技术限制。
AI.method: 概念性系统设计方法，提出了"准备度和可行性感知的激励框架"，该框架基于概率性任务可行性而非刚性时间阈值来评估和补偿。
AI.findings: 实时可见性本身无法产生可靠结果，因为激励结构错配会扭曲参与者行为。将激励作为实时系统的核心架构层，基于任务可行性概率而非刚性时间阈值的框架能够实现更稳定、公平和可扩展的平台性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了概念性系统设计视角，阐述了将激励作为实时系统核心架构层的理论框架，整合了预测建模、激励对齐和行为反馈的原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模运营平台提供了整合预测建模、激励对齐和行为反馈的设计原则，帮助平台在不确定性下实现更稳定、公平和可扩展的性能。

detail.abstract:
This chapter traces the trajectory of two major US sustainability initiatives, the Securities & Exchange Commission’s climate risk disclosure rule and California’s mandates requiring disclosure of climate-related risks and greenhouse gas emissions. The chapter explores the motivation behind both efforts and explains how the backlash against disclosure mandates led to challenges that in both cases have, to date, been successful. The success of the challenges has been due, in part, to distinctive features of the US regulatory structure.

At the same time, these features offer unique possibilities for experimentation, innovation and incremental regulatory reform. As the debate over corporate sustainability continues, we offer cautious optimism about the potential of the US to respond to its demands.

detail.abstract: Seasonal employment in Greece, particularly within the hospitality and agricultural sectors, is associated with high job demands, long working hours, and employment insecurity. This study investigates the occupational stressors experienced by seasonal workers and the coping mechanisms they adopt, with a particular focus on work-life balance. Ten participants were recruited and interviewed using semi-structured interviews. The data were analyzed through Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA). The findings indicate significant disruptions to work-life balance, alongside physical and emotional exhaustion. Participants reported extensive reliance on maladaptive coping strategies, including smoking and alcohol consumption, while others described adaptive strategies such as mindfulness practices and physical exercise. The results highlight the need for organizational and policy-level interventions, including fair scheduling practices, mental health support, and strengthened labor protection. Overall, the study contributes to a deeper understanding of occupational well-being within precarious and seasonally structured employment contexts in Greece.

detail.abstract: For decades, leadership-whether in corporate, organizational, or equine contexts-has often relied on pressure-and-compliance models. Traditional paradigms assume that subordinates and teams will align through authority alone. Emerging research in psychophysiology suggests that such approaches may have measurable physiological and behavioral costs. In this research-informed essay, patterns of physiological and behavioral alignment across human-human and human-animal interactions are examined. Dyadic synchrony-rhythmic alignment of physiological and behavioral responses-appears as a biologically grounded pattern of relational alignment. Conceptual coherence provides a framework for understanding how trust, congruence, and engagement may influence coordination, learning, and adaptive interaction patterns. Observations from structured human-equine sessions illustrate how calm, guided interactions facilitate postural and micro-movement synchrony, reinforcing the conceptual lens of coherence for leadership.

AI.tldr: 这篇研究性文章探讨了传统压力-顺从领导模式的生理和行为成本，提出了基于生理同步的"一致性"框架作为替代方案，并通过人-马互动案例展示了平静引导如何促进同步协调。
AI.research_question: 压力-顺从领导模式对下属和团队有什么生理和行为影响？如何通过生理和行为同步（一致性）框架来改善领导效果？
AI.motivation: 传统领导模式过度依赖权威和压力，可能带来生理和行为上的负面成本，需要探索更符合生物本性的协调方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理生理学、二元同步理论（生理和行为反应的节奏性对齐）、一致性概念框架（信任、一致性和参与如何影响协调）
AI.method: 研究性论文结合结构化人-马互动观察，分析生理和行为同步模式
AI.findings: 平静、引导式的互动能促进姿势和微动作同步，支持一致性作为领导力的概念框架；传统压力-顺从模式有可测量的生理和行为成本
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于生理同步的"一致性"领导框架，将二元同步理论应用于领导力研究，挑战了传统权威领导范式
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了基于平静引导而非压力控制的实践方法，通过促进生理同步来改善团队协调、学习和适应能力

title: Epistemic Governance and Institutional Trust: A Domain-Agnostic Intervention Layer for Decision-Making Under Complexity

detail.title: Epistemic Governance and Institutional Trust: A Domain-Agnostic Intervention Layer for Decision-Making Under Complexity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper builds on the author’s earlier work, Epistemic Governance: Rethinking Trust in Computational Systems. The Trust Card concept, an extension of the Epistemic Governance concept, is author’s own work and was developed independently. Elements of the concept were used in policy-facing materials circulated to government stakeholders prior to the publication of this paper. Responsibility for the views expressed rests solely with the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: No funding has been obtained for this work.

detail.abstract:
Institutions across sectors increasingly rely on complex systems - algorithmic, computational, and socio-technical, to inform consequential decisions, while lacking full access to or understanding of how those systems produce outcomes. Prevailing governance approaches emphasise transparency, explainability, performance metrics, or ethical principles. While important, these approaches do not fully resolve a central institutional problem: how decisions can be made legitimately and defended under conditions of partial knowledge.

This paper introduces epistemic governance as a distinct, domain-agnostic governance paradigm concerned with the institutional conditions under which confidence in system-mediated outcomes is established, bounded, and justified. Rather than governing computation directly, epistemic governance focuses on governing institutional action by structuring authority, oversight, and conditions of reliance when full transparency or certainty is unattainable.

As part of this framework, the paper conceptualises Trust Cards as one application of epistemic governance. Trust Cards are defined as institutional governance artefacts with a two-layer structure, separating internal epistemic assurance from external interpretive signalling. This separation enables institutions to preserve internal discretion while maintaining external legitimacy. The paper is conceptual in scope and intentionally does not specify operational implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知治理"作为新的治理范式，关注在部分知识条件下如何建立、界定和证明对系统产出结果的信心，并引入"信任卡"作为该框架的应用工具。
AI.research_question: 在无法完全透明或确定的情况下，机构如何合法地做出决策并为其辩护？
AI.motivation: 各领域机构日益依赖复杂系统（算法、计算、社会技术系统）做出重要决策，但缺乏对这些系统如何产生结果的完全访问或理解。现有治理方法（透明度、可解释性、性能指标、伦理原则）未能完全解决部分知识条件下的决策合法性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知治理理论、制度理论、知识治理、信任理论
AI.method: 概念性研究，理论框架构建，不涉及具体操作实施
AI.findings: 提出了认知治理作为领域无关的治理范式，关注在无法获得完全透明度或确定性时，如何通过结构化权威、监督和依赖条件来治理制度行动。提出了"信任卡"作为认知治理的应用，具有两层结构：内部认知保证和外部解释信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出认知治理作为新的治理范式；2. 将治理重点从直接治理计算转向治理制度行动；3. 引入信任卡概念，分离内部保证和外部信号；4. 为解决部分知识条件下的决策合法性问题提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构在复杂系统治理中提供新的治理思路；2. 信任卡设计使机构能在保持内部自由裁量权的同时维持外部合法性；3. 为跨领域复杂系统治理提供通用框架；4. 强调制度条件和依赖关系而非单纯技术透明度。

title: A Systematic Literature Review on Cost Structure Optimization and Financial Sustainability of a Dialysis Center: Break-Even and Sensitivity Analysis for Strategic Decision-Making
affiliations: , WORLD CITI COLLEGES and World Citi Colleges - Quezon City - Graduate School Department

detail.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Cost Structure Optimization and Financial Sustainability of a Dialysis Center: Break-Even and Sensitivity Analysis for Strategic Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Hemodialysis facilities have high fixed costs that are challenging to change. Along with expenses for water systems, dialysis machines, and facility fees, these are primarily distributed to employees as pay. Other significant variable cost during every dialysis session is dialyzers, bloodlines, concentrates, disposables, medicines, and utilities. In different low-and middleincome countries, variable expenses take a greater proportion of total expenditures depending on the mode of acquisition of commodities, the stability of the supply chain, and the manner of payment. Due to this, any small variations in the quantity of patients attended to will affect the amount of money significantly. The break-even point is calculated by the contribution of each session to the fixed costs coverage and the possibility of the dialysis center to maximize its capacity. The dialysis facilities can enhance the profitability as they can reduce the amount of treatment expenses per case by increasing their number of treatments since fixed costs are distributed among the sessions. Even slight changes in the fixed costs imply that a facility must offer much more sessions to meet such costs. The breakeven point may also rise in case the variable costs rise. Annual per-patient hemodialysis expenses in countries with low and middleincome are quite diverse with some financial barriers to the centers without the government cover or subsidies. Consequently, free-standing dialysis centers in effect have an increased risk of financial loss because of low safety margins that make it easy to make losses, restrain investments and reduce the services even though the break-even point is close to, not to mention difficulties in the nature of irregular cash flow and late payment. Therefore, dialysis centers must pay an emphasis on the fact that their resources are to be managed successfully, there has to be enough cash on hand, and they have to receive supplies. Additional studies are required to effortlessly identify the effectiveness of standard costing and scenario planning among various types of centers and systems of payment.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了低收入和中等收入国家血液透析设施的成本结构，指出固定成本高且难以调整，可变成本占比因采购方式、供应链稳定性和支付方式而异。透析中心需要通过增加治疗次数来分摊固定成本以提高盈利能力，但固定成本的微小变化就需要大幅增加治疗次数才能达到盈亏平衡。文章强调了资源管理、现金流和供应链稳定的重要性。
AI.research_question: 低收入和中等收入国家的血液透析设施如何通过成本管理和运营优化来提高财务可持续性？
AI.motivation: 血液透析设施在低收入和中等收入国家面临财务挑战，固定成本高且难以调整，可变成本占比大，患者数量的小幅波动就会显著影响财务状况。许多透析中心因安全边际低、现金流不稳定而面临财务风险，需要有效的成本管理和运营策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本-数量-利润分析（CVP分析）、盈亏平衡点分析、固定成本与可变成本理论、规模经济理论
AI.method: 概念性分析，基于成本结构分析透析设施的财务特征，探讨固定成本、可变成本与治疗次数的关系，以及盈亏平衡点的计算和影响因素。
AI.findings: 1. 透析设施固定成本高（水处理系统、透析机、设施费用等），主要分配给员工薪酬；2. 可变成本（透析器、管路、浓缩液、耗材等）在低收入和中等收入国家占比更大，受采购方式、供应链稳定性和支付方式影响；3. 患者数量的小幅变化会显著影响财务状况；4. 增加治疗次数可以分摊固定成本，提高盈利能力；5. 固定成本的微小变化需要大幅增加治疗次数才能达到盈亏平衡；6. 可变成本上升也会提高盈亏平衡点；7. 独立透析中心因安全边际低、现金流不稳定而面临较高财务风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将成本-数量-利润分析应用于低收入和中等收入国家的医疗设施管理，特别强调了在资源受限环境下透析设施的财务特征和运营挑战，为医疗设施财务管理理论提供了具体情境分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为透析中心管理者提供了成本管理和运营优化的具体指导；2. 强调了资源管理、现金流充足和供应链稳定的重要性；3. 指出需要根据采购方式、支付系统和供应链状况调整成本管理策略；4. 建议进一步研究标准成本法和情景规划在不同类型中心和支付系统中的适用性。

title: The Erosion of Global Disease Research Investment in a Fragmenting World: National Egocentrism, Rising Military Expenditure, War Impacts on Health, and Migration Pressures (2020-2026)
affiliations: University of Yaounde I - Faculty of Science

detail.title: The Erosion of Global Disease Research Investment in a Fragmenting World: National Egocentrism, Rising Military Expenditure, War Impacts on Health, and Migration Pressures (2020-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no funding.

detail.abstract: Between 2020 and March 2026, the global community experienced unprecedented and compounding stresses to its collective security architecture. The COVID-19 pandemic revealed that infectious diseases constitute borderless threats capable of destabilizing societies simultaneously. Yet paradoxically, the post-pandemic period has been characterized by escalating military expendituredriven by wars in Ukraine (2022-present), Gaza (2023-present), Sudan, and most critically, a major regional war erupting in the Middle East in March 2026-while investment in disease-related research has declined following its emergency surge. Concurrently, conflict-induced displacement has reached record levels, and direct war impacts have destroyed health infrastructure across multiple regions, creating new disease vulnerabilities. The March 2026 escalation has now disrupted global health supply chains, suspended operations at WHO's Dubai emergency logistics hub, and created new disease surveillance gaps across 16 directly affected countries. In this Review, we argue that national egocentrism, securitized responses to migration and conflict, and escalating geopolitical rivalries have collectively reshaped global investment priorities in ways that fundamentally undermine long-term human security. By integrating trends in military spending, war-related health destruction, disease burden, population mobility, and research funding, we highlight a growing structural vulnerability: the systematic underinvestment in health research despite clear evidence that pathogens-amplified by conflict and displacement-represent the most universal and recurrent threat to humanity. Drawing lessons from COVID-19 and multiple concurrent wars, we call for renewed global solidarity and sustained, predictable investment in health research, commensurate with military spending, as the only viable foundation for resilient global security.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2020-2026年间全球安全架构面临的复合压力，指出军事开支激增与健康研究投资下降的矛盾趋势，强调病原体（通过冲突和流离失所放大）是对人类最普遍、最反复的威胁，呼吁全球团结并建立与军费相当的可持续健康研究投资体系。
AI.research_question: 全球投资优先事项如何因国家自我中心主义、对移民和冲突的安全化应对以及地缘政治竞争而重塑，从而破坏长期人类安全？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行揭示了传染病作为无国界威胁的能力，但后疫情时期却出现了军事开支激增与疾病相关研究投资下降的矛盾现象，同时冲突导致的流离失所达到创纪录水平，战争直接破坏了多地区卫生基础设施，创造了新的疾病脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类安全框架、全球安全架构理论、投资优先事项的政治经济学、地缘政治竞争对公共卫生的影响、冲突与健康脆弱性的关系。
AI.method: 整合分析军事开支趋势、战争相关的健康破坏、疾病负担、人口流动和研究资金数据，通过多变量趋势分析揭示结构性脆弱性。
AI.findings: 国家自我中心主义、对移民和冲突的安全化应对以及升级的地缘政治竞争共同重塑了全球投资优先事项，导致对健康研究的系统性投资不足，尽管有明确证据表明病原体（通过冲突和流离失所放大）是对人类最普遍、最反复的威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了人类安全理论，强调健康研究投资作为全球安全基础的重要性；2）提出了"健康研究投资-军事开支失衡"作为全球安全结构性脆弱性的分析框架；3）揭示了地缘政治竞争如何通过资源分配机制削弱长期人类安全。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）呼吁全球团结和可持续、可预测的健康研究投资；2）建议建立与军事开支相当的卫生研究投资体系；3）为政策制定者提供基于证据的投资优先事项调整建议；4）强调加强全球卫生供应链和疾病监测系统的重要性。

title: Predicting Adverse Selection in High-Frequency Cryptocurrency Markets Using Gradient Boosting
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati and Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati

detail.title: Predicting Adverse Selection in High-Frequency Cryptocurrency Markets Using Gradient Boosting
detail.abstract: We predict adverse selection in high-frequency cryptocurrency markets using gradient boosting (LightGBM) trained on 31,081,463 second-level observations of BTC/USDT perpetual futures on Bybit, spanning February 1, 2025 through February 16, 2026 (381 raw daily files). Our toxicity label (tox_A) identifies seconds where strong directional order flow is followed by sustained price continuation over a five-second horizon, constructed using adaptive rolling quantile thresholds calibrated to a one-hour lookback windowa regime-aware design that accommodates the substantial variation in toxicity rates observed across the sample, ranging from 0.081% in September 2025 to 0.795% in February 2025. The model is estimated in a strict walk-forward regime: the first 21 days serve as the initial training window, with 360 out-of-sample evaluation days beginning February 22, 2025, eliminating any forward-looking bias. The composite TailScore-the product of the classifier's predicted toxicity probability and its predicted 99th-percentile absolute price move-jointly captures the likelihood and severity of an adverse selection event. At a 0.1% gate, the TailScore achieves monthly ROC-AUC between 0.668 and 0.921 across the full out-of-sample period. The central result is that flagging the top 0.1% of TailScore-ranked seconds reduces CVaR99 by 2.33%-a reduction 25.85 times greater than an equal-sized random gate. This efficiency ratio persists across all tested gate widths from 0.1% to 5.0%, decaying from 25.85x to 3.50x as the gate widens, consistent with the model's signal being concentrated in the extreme upper tail of the score distribution. Monthly evaluation confirms robustness: efficiency ranges from 15.18x to 34.88x across all 13 evaluation months, with no month falling below the random gating benchmark. An ablation study isolates the contribution of the TailScore against a pure GBM classifier and a VPIN proxy. The classifier alone achieves an efficiency of 2.11x and the VPIN proxy 0.30x-the latter falling below the random benchmark-at identical gate rates. The gap between TailScore (25.85x) and classifier alone (2.11x) demonstrates that the severity component is the dominant driver of CVaR reduction: predicting that a toxic event will occur is insufficient; predicting how large the move will be is what determines whether the gate concentrates on the seconds that matter most for tail risk.

AI.tldr: 使用梯度提升模型(LightGBM)预测加密货币高频市场中的逆向选择风险，通过TailScore指标(毒性概率×预期价格波动幅度)在381天BTC/USDT永续期货数据上实现CVaR99降低2.33%，效率比随机筛选高25.85倍。
AI.research_question: 如何有效预测高频加密货币市场中的逆向选择风险，并降低尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场波动剧烈，逆向选择风险显著，传统风险模型在高频环境下效果有限，需要开发能够同时预测事件发生概率和严重程度的综合指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向选择理论、高频市场微观结构、尾部风险度量(CVaR)、机器学习在金融预测中的应用、VPIN(知情交易概率)理论。
AI.method: 使用LightGBM梯度提升模型，基于31,081,463秒级BTC/USDT永续期货数据(2025年2月1日至2026年2月16日)，采用严格的前向滚动验证方法，构建TailScore综合指标(毒性概率×99%分位数绝对价格变动)。
AI.findings: TailScore在0.1%阈值下月ROC-AUC为0.668-0.921，筛选前0.1%秒数可降低CVaR99达2.33%，效率比随机筛选高25.85倍。严重程度预测是降低尾部风险的主要驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出TailScore综合指标，将事件概率预测与严重程度预测相结合；证明在高频加密货币市场中，严重程度预测比单纯的事件发生预测对降低尾部风险更为关键。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币交易者和风险管理者提供有效的逆向选择预警工具；TailScore模型可集成到实时交易系统中，帮助识别和规避高风险时段，优化风险管理策略。

title: Understanding Patient Experience in Mental Health Counseling and Support Services (2021–2026): A Patient-Centered and Administrative Analysis of Effective and Ineffective Care Approaches

detail.title: Understanding Patient Experience in Mental Health Counseling and Support Services (2021–2026): A Patient-Centered and Administrative Analysis of Effective and Ineffective Care Approaches

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Mental health services have expanded significantly over the past decade, yet many individuals seeking counseling, therapy, or behavioral support report dissatisfaction with the care they receive. Research published between 2021 and 2026 increasingly emphasizes that patient outcomes in mental health care are influenced not only by clinical treatment methods but also by relational dynamics, communication practices, and system design. This paper reviews contemporary literature examining how patients experience interactions with counselors, therapists, and support specialists, and which care approaches contribute to improved engagement and treatment outcomes. Particular attention is given to therapeutic alliance, shared decision-making, cultural responsiveness, trauma-informed practice, and measurement-based care. The analysis also explores the administrative implications of these findings, emphasizing how organizational structures and clinical workflows shape the patient experience. By examining both empirical research and real-world case observations, this paper argues that effective mental health support requires adaptable, patient-centered communication and system-level accountability mechanisms that align care delivery with patient needs.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文综述了2021-2026年间关于心理健康服务中患者体验的研究，强调治疗关系、沟通实践和系统设计对患者满意度和治疗效果的影响，提出需要以患者为中心的沟通和系统级问责机制。
AI.research_question: 心理健康服务中，患者与咨询师、治疗师和支持专家的互动体验如何影响治疗参与度和结果？哪些护理方法有助于改善患者体验和治疗效果？
AI.motivation: 尽管过去十年心理健康服务显著扩展，但许多寻求咨询、治疗或行为支持的患者对接受的护理表示不满意。需要理解影响患者体验和结果的因素，以改善服务质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治疗联盟理论、共享决策理论、文化响应性理论、创伤知情实践理论、测量导向护理理论、患者中心护理理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析2021-2026年间的当代研究文献，结合实证研究和现实案例观察
AI.findings: 患者结果不仅受临床治疗方法影响，还受到关系动态、沟通实践和系统设计的影响。治疗联盟、共享决策、文化响应性、创伤知情实践和测量导向护理是改善患者体验和结果的关键因素。组织结构和临床工作流程显著塑造患者体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了多个理论框架来解释心理健康服务中患者体验的多维度影响因素，提出了一个综合性的患者中心护理理论模型，强调系统层面因素的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为心理健康服务机构提供了具体的改进建议：采用适应性强的患者中心沟通策略，建立系统级问责机制，调整组织结构和临床工作流程以更好地满足患者需求，实施文化响应性和创伤知情实践。

title: Accounting for imperfect displacement in life cycle assessment for refurbishing and remanufacturing operations
affiliations: University of Padua, Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business, INSEAD and INSEAD

detail.title: Accounting for imperfect displacement in life cycle assessment for refurbishing and remanufacturing operations
detail.abstract: Refurbishing and remanufacturing are often championed for their potential to reduce environmental impacts, yet their true benefits remain a subject of debate. A primary challenge is imperfect displacement-where refurbished/remanufactured units do not fully substitute for new products-leading to rebound effects that can offset environmental gains. Recent Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) research has begun to address this through a displacement rate (DR), which compares the quantity of new products displaced to the quantity of refurbished/remanufactured products supplied to the market. However, practical approaches to estimating realistic DRs remain limited, with most studies resorting to subjective assumptions. This article shows how to endogenize DR by using an established modeling approach from the Operations Management literature. This involves modeling firm and customer decisions and estimating DR as a function of cost, market, and operational parameters. We propose that companies must verify whether this market-driven DR exceeds the 'break-even' DR-the threshold required for a circular strategy to achieve net environmental savings, as calculated through LCA. We demonstrate these notions through a case study in the electronics industry. Our results highlight that, for products with usedominated impacts, companies must strategically select their target markets, as geography significantly influences both break-even and market-driven displacement. Overall, we provide scholars and practitioners with an interdisciplinary framework to evaluate the environmental benefits of refurbishing/remanufacturing strategies. This framework offers a practical calculation with feasible data requirements, enabling firms to simulate prospective scenarios and identify actionable levers to influence displacement with both environmental sustainability and profitability in mind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将置换率内生化以评估翻新/再制造环境效益的跨学科框架，通过运营管理模型将置换率作为成本、市场和运营参数的函数，并引入"盈亏平衡置换率"概念，帮助企业评估循环策略的净环境效益。
AI.research_question: 如何准确评估翻新和再制造策略的环境效益，特别是在考虑不完全置换和反弹效应的情况下？如何将置换率内生化，避免主观假设，提供实用的评估框架？
AI.motivation: 翻新和再制造常被认为能减少环境影响，但其真实效益存在争议。主要挑战是不完全置换问题——翻新/再制造产品不能完全替代新产品，导致反弹效应可能抵消环境收益。现有LCA研究使用置换率，但缺乏实用的估算方法，大多依赖主观假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 生命周期评估(LCA)理论；2) 置换率(DR)概念；3) 运营管理中的企业决策模型；4) 消费者行为理论；5) 循环经济理论；6) 反弹效应理论。
AI.method: 采用跨学科方法：1) 从运营管理文献中引入已建立的建模方法；2) 建立企业和消费者决策模型；3) 将置换率内生化，作为成本、市场和运营参数的函数；4) 引入"盈亏平衡置换率"概念；5) 通过电子行业案例研究进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 1) 对于使用阶段环境影响主导的产品，企业必须战略性地选择目标市场，因为地理位置显著影响盈亏平衡置换率和市场驱动的置换率；2) 市场驱动的置换率必须超过盈亏平衡置换率，循环策略才能实现净环境节约；3) 提出的框架提供了实用的计算方法，数据需求可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将置换率内生化，避免主观假设；2) 提出跨学科评估框架，整合LCA和运营管理；3) 引入"盈亏平衡置换率"作为关键评估指标；4) 为循环经济环境效益评估提供理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业提供实用的计算框架，数据需求可行；2) 帮助企业模拟前瞻性情景；3) 识别可操作的杠杆来影响置换率；4) 在环境可持续性和盈利能力之间找到平衡；5) 指导企业战略选择目标市场。

title: Refugee Return
affiliations: , European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, Ifo Institute and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Refugee Return

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite rising refugee numbers worldwide, refugees’ return decisions remain poorly understood. Prior work examines either intentions or realized return, but not both. We fielded a ten-wave panel of Ukrainian refugees, linking prewar home municipalities to geocoded conflict and territorial control data and eliciting war expectations. Intentions strongly predict behavior: by 2025, 42% of those planning to return soon in 2022 had returned, versus 1% of those planning to settle abroad. Increasing conflict in the home municipality reduces return there but barely affects return to Ukraine overall. More pessimistic war expectations explain 21% of the decline in return intentions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过十轮乌克兰难民面板调查，发现返回意愿能强烈预测实际返回行为，冲突加剧会减少难民返回原居住地但不影响整体返回乌克兰的比例，悲观的战争预期解释了21%的返回意愿下降。
AI.research_question: 难民返回决策的决定因素是什么？返回意愿如何预测实际返回行为？冲突和战争预期如何影响难民的返回决策？
AI.motivation: 全球难民数量上升，但难民的返回决策机制仍未被充分理解。先前研究要么只关注返回意愿，要么只关注实际返回行为，缺乏将两者联系起来的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 难民返回决策理论，行为意愿与实际行动的关系理论，冲突地理学，预期理论在难民决策中的应用。
AI.method: 对乌克兰难民进行十轮面板调查，将战前居住地市政数据与地理编码的冲突和领土控制数据关联，并收集战争预期数据。
AI.findings: 1. 返回意愿强烈预测实际行为：到2025年，2022年计划尽快返回的人中有42%已返回，而计划在国外定居的人中只有1%返回。2. 原居住地冲突加剧会减少返回该地的难民，但几乎不影响整体返回乌克兰的比例。3. 更悲观的战争预期解释了21%的返回意愿下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将难民返回意愿与实际行为联系起来，建立了预测模型；揭示了冲突地理分布对返回决策的异质性影响；量化了战争预期在难民决策中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为难民政策制定者提供预测工具，帮助识别可能返回的难民群体；为冲突地区重建规划提供依据；为国际援助分配提供决策支持。

title: Energy Markets at War: The Effect of the Russian Invasion of Ukraine on Refinery Margins
affiliations: and German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin), Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Department of Economics

detail.title: Energy Markets at War: The Effect of the Russian Invasion of Ukraine on Refinery Margins

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 on refinery margins, i.e. the difference between wholesale prices for road fuels (gasoline and diesel) and oil prices in Europe and Germany in particular. Following the Russian invasion of Ukraine, wholesale road fuel prices net of taxes rose by more than 50 cents per liter, whereas crude oil prices increased by only about 30 cents per liter. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we compare refinery margins in Germany with those on the Amsterdam–Rotterdam–Antwerp (ARA) spot market, which serves as a European benchmark price. The results indicate that refinery margins in Germany increased by approximately 5–6 cents per liter relative to the ARA region after the invasion. We attribute this differential primarily to Germany’s strong dependence on Russian Ural crude oil imports and to the presence of regional market power among German refineries. We further document substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects across both time and regions. In addition, the invasion was associated with a significant decline in fuel demand, with gasoline consumption falling by about 13% and diesel consumption by approximately 9%.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文评估了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰对欧洲特别是德国炼油厂利润率的影响，发现德国炼油厂利润率相对ARA地区上升了5-6欧分/升，主要归因于德国对俄罗斯乌拉尔原油进口的依赖和区域市场力量。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰如何影响欧洲特别是德国的炼油厂利润率？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治冲击（如俄罗斯入侵乌克兰）对能源市场的影响，特别是对炼油厂利润率的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场力量理论、区域市场结构和供应链依赖理论，分析地缘政治冲击对炼油利润率的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法，比较德国炼油厂利润率与阿姆斯特丹-鹿特丹-安特卫普现货市场基准价格的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 入侵后德国炼油厂利润率相对ARA地区上升5-6欧分/升；2. 主要归因于德国对俄罗斯乌拉尔原油的依赖和区域市场力量；3. 汽油消费下降13%，柴油下降9%；4. 存在显著的时间和地区异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了地缘政治冲击通过供应链依赖和市场力量影响炼油利润率的具体机制；2. 扩展了双重差分法在能源市场分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供能源安全风险评估依据；2. 帮助企业理解地缘政治风险对炼油业务的影响；3. 为能源市场监管提供实证证据。

title: Climate-Resilient Built Environments in Scotland: Planning Systems, Adaptation Strategies, and Implications for Medium-Sized Cities

detail.title: Climate-Resilient Built Environments in Scotland: Planning Systems, Adaptation Strategies, and Implications for Medium-Sized Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Climate change poses increasing risks to the built environment, requiring cities to adapt urban systems while meeting ambitious emissions reduction targets. In Scotland, national climate commitments and recent planning reforms position the planning system as a key mechanism for delivering climate-resilient development. However, the capacity of medium-sized cities to operationalise resilience objectives within everyday planning practice remains under-examined. This paper explores how planning systems shape climate resilience in the built environment of medium-sized Scottish cities, with particular attention to governance structures, policy integration, and local implementation. Drawing on qualitative analysis of Scottish planning and climate policy frameworks, the study examines how resilience objectives are defined, prioritised, and translated into local planning decisions. The paper identifies persistent gaps between strategic ambition and delivery, driven by fragmented policy integration, institutional capacity constraints, and competing development pressures. It argues that strengthening planning-led coordination across housing, transport, and regeneration is essential for advancing climate-resilient built environments in medium-sized cities. The paper contributes to emerging debates on climate-resilient urbanism beyond major metropolitan contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨苏格兰中等城市如何通过规划系统塑造建成环境的气候韧性，发现战略目标与实施之间存在差距，需加强跨部门协调。
AI.research_question: 规划系统如何塑造苏格兰中等城市建成环境的气候韧性？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对建成环境风险增加，需要城市在减排同时适应气候变化。苏格兰的国家气候承诺和规划改革将规划系统定位为提供气候韧性发展的关键机制，但中等城市在日常规划实践中实施韧性目标的能力尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候韧性城市主义、规划治理理论、政策实施理论
AI.method: 对苏格兰规划和气候政策框架进行定性分析，研究韧性目标如何定义、优先排序并转化为地方规划决策
AI.findings: 研究发现战略雄心与实施之间存在持续差距，这由碎片化的政策整合、机构能力限制和竞争性的发展压力所驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 为超越主要大都市背景的气候韧性城市主义新兴辩论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 指出加强跨住房、交通和再生领域的规划主导协调对于推进中等城市气候韧性建成环境至关重要

title: Returns to Scale and Strategic Regimes in Innovation Races
affiliations: Universität Osnabrück and Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity at the University of Oldenburg

detail.title: Returns to Scale and Strategic Regimes in Innovation Races

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model in which the productivity of joint research governs strategic investment timing in innovation races. Departing from the standard assumption that discovery rates scale proportionally with the number of active firms, we allow research to exhibit decreasing or increasing returns, thereby endogenizing the aggressiveness of innovation competition. We show that returns to joint research determine whether innovation races exhibit preemption or coordination. When research efforts are substitutes, follower entry is unattractive, generating a first-mover advantage and a preemption equilibrium. When complementarities are sufficiently strong, the gains from early investment vanish and firms invest simultaneously. The model thus identifies a regime shift in innovation races: competition accelerates investment under decreasing returns but promotes coordinated entry under increasing returns. These findings highlight the research technology as a central determinant of market dynamics and provide a unified perspective on heterogeneous patterns of innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个动态模型，研究联合研究的生产率如何影响创新竞赛中的战略投资时机。不同于传统假设，本文允许研究存在规模收益递减或递增，从而内生化了创新竞争的激烈程度。研究发现，联合研究的收益决定了创新竞赛是呈现先占还是协调均衡。
AI.research_question: 联合研究的生产率如何影响创新竞赛中的战略投资时机？研究技术的规模收益（递减或递增）如何内生决定创新竞争的激烈程度和均衡类型？
AI.motivation: 传统创新竞赛模型通常假设发现率与活跃企业数量成比例，忽略了研究可能存在的规模收益变化。现实中，研究活动可能存在互补性或替代性，这会影响企业的投资决策和竞争动态。需要建立一个更符合现实的研究技术模型来理解创新竞赛的均衡模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论、创新竞赛理论、战略投资时机理论、研究技术规模收益理论（规模收益递减/递增）、先占均衡与协调均衡理论
AI.method: 构建动态模型，其中联合研究的生产率内生决定创新竞赛的激烈程度。模型允许研究存在规模收益递减或递增，分析企业在不同研究技术条件下的最优投资时机决策，推导均衡类型（先占均衡或协调均衡）。
AI.findings:
1. 当研究努力是替代品（规模收益递减）时，跟随者进入缺乏吸引力，产生先发优势，形成先占均衡。
2. 当互补性足够强（规模收益递增）时，早期投资的收益消失，企业同时投资，形成协调均衡。
3. 创新竞赛存在制度转变：竞争在规模收益递减时加速投资，在规模收益递增时促进协调进入。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将研究技术的规模收益特征内生化到创新竞赛模型中，扩展了传统理论。
2. 识别了创新竞赛中的制度转变：从先占均衡到协调均衡的转变取决于研究技术的性质。
3. 提供了理解创新竞赛异质模式的统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业制定创新投资策略提供指导：根据研究技术的性质决定是抢先投资还是协调投资。
2. 为政策制定者理解不同行业的创新动态提供理论依据。
3. 帮助管理者识别所在行业的研究技术特征，制定相应的竞争战略。

title: Decoding the small ruminant value chain in Punjab, India
affiliations: Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University

detail.title: Decoding the small ruminant value chain in Punjab, India
detail.abstract: Small ruminant farming is becoming a popular choice in the Punjab state of India thanks to its high profitability and low input costs. Despite its increasing contribution to rural livelihoods and food security, the small ruminant value chain remains inadequately documented, underscoring the need to examine value chain actors, practices, and risk points. This study mapped and systematically profiled risk within the small ruminant value chain in Punjab, India, to identify structural inefficiencies, governance deficiencies, and embedded biosecurity vulnerabilities. A cross-sectional survey of 385 farmers across 11 districts was conducted using structured interviews and key informant inputs. Descriptive and flow-based (Sankey) analyses were applied to quantify input and output linkages. The results indicated that exclusive goat farming predominated (84.68%) over sheep or mixed farming systems, with 88.83% practicing extensive grazing on common lands. Animal procurement was largely trader-mediated, and record keeping was negligible. Major sale destinations included local traders or middlemen (45%), fellow farmers (41.04%), and butchers (14.28%). Preventive healthcare adoption remained low (vaccination 29.87%, deworming 27.27%), while informal treatment practices dominated. Marketing was trader-led, with 45 per cent of animals sold through middlemen and limited price discovery mechanisms. Distress sale of sick animals and absence of organized carcass disposal were identified as critical risk nodes. The value chain operates within a low-input–low-output equilibrium sustained by informal governance, weak institutional integration, and limited extension penetration. These structural features generate productivity losses and potential animal and public health externalities. Strengthening biosecurity adoption, formal market linkages, record-based management, and extension-led institutional integration is essential for improving resilience, value capture, and sustainability of small ruminant systems in similar informal economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了印度旁遮普邦小反刍动物价值链，发现该价值链以非正式治理、制度整合薄弱为特征，存在生物安全漏洞、价格发现机制有限等风险节点，需要加强生物安全采用、正式市场联系和基于记录的管理。
AI.research_question: 印度旁遮普邦小反刍动物价值链中的风险点、结构效率低下和治理缺陷是什么？
AI.motivation: 小反刍动物养殖在旁遮普邦日益重要，但价值链缺乏充分记录，需要研究价值链参与者、实践和风险点，以支持农村生计和粮食安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值链分析理论，重点关注结构效率、治理机制和生物安全漏洞。
AI.method: 横断面调查：对11个地区的385名农民进行结构化访谈和关键信息提供者输入；描述性分析和基于流程的桑基图分析量化投入产出联系。
AI.findings: 1. 山羊养殖占主导地位(84.68%)，88.83%采用公共土地粗放放牧；2. 动物采购主要通过贸易商中介，记录保存极少；3. 主要销售目的地：当地贸易商(45%)、其他农民(41.04%)、屠夫(14.28%)；4. 预防性医疗采用率低(疫苗接种29.87%，驱虫27.27%)，非正式治疗实践占主导；5. 市场由贸易商主导，价格发现机制有限；6. 病畜紧急销售和无组织尸体处理是关键风险节点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了非正式经济中小反刍动物价值链的"低投入-低产出均衡"特征；2. 识别了非正式治理、制度整合薄弱和推广渗透有限如何导致生产力损失和公共卫生外部性；3. 提供了价值链风险分析的系统框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了生物安全漏洞、市场失灵和治理缺陷等具体风险节点；2. 提出了加强生物安全采用、建立正式市场联系、实施基于记录的管理和推广主导的制度整合等具体建议；3. 为类似非正式经济中的小反刍动物系统提高韧性、价值获取和可持续性提供了政策方向。

title: Abatement through Corrective Taxation in Commercial Aviation

detail.title: Abatement through Corrective Taxation in Commercial Aviation

declarations.funderStatement: This project received funding from SNF to purchase data and cover other research expenses (https://snf.no/en/about/about-snf/).

detail.abstract: Corrective taxation has the potential to reduce the negative environmental impacts of aviation, particularly carbon emissions, as well as air pollution. However, in a setting with demand heterogeneity and imperfect competition, optimally setting a tax is not trivial. I find that lower-elasticity consumers are 7 times more price-sensitive than business consumers. I simulate two alternative taxation schemes in Denmark (jet fuel taxes, and a fixed per-flight tax, as in Norway) and find that taxes have limited efficacy in internalizing externalities when considering only the social cost of carbon.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了航空业纠正性税收的有效性，发现在需求异质性和不完全竞争环境下，税收政策在内部化环境外部性方面效果有限，特别是仅考虑碳社会成本时。
AI.research_question: 在需求异质性和不完全竞争的市场环境下，如何最优设定航空业纠正性税收以有效内部化环境外部性？
AI.motivation: 航空业对环境有显著的负面影响（碳排放和空气污染），纠正性税收是潜在的解决方案，但在需求异质性和不完全竞争条件下，最优税收设定变得复杂，需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的纠正性税收理论、需求异质性理论、不完全竞争市场理论、外部性内部化理论
AI.method: 实证分析（发现低弹性消费者比商务消费者价格敏感度高7倍）+ 模拟研究（模拟丹麦的两种税收方案：航空燃油税和挪威式的固定每航班税）
AI.findings: 1. 消费者需求存在显著异质性：低弹性消费者价格敏感度是商务消费者的7倍；2. 仅考虑碳社会成本时，税收在内部化外部性方面效果有限；3. 两种税收方案（燃油税和固定每航班税）在丹麦情境下的模拟结果显示了税收政策的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在需求异质性和不完全竞争条件下扩展了纠正性税收理论；2. 揭示了消费者异质性对税收政策效果的重要影响；3. 为航空业环境税收设计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了航空税收设计的实证依据；2. 指出仅基于碳社会成本的税收政策效果有限；3. 建议考虑更全面的外部性内部化策略；4. 为丹麦等国家的航空税收政策提供了具体参考。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Banking as a Driver of Financial Inclusion for Reducing Poverty and Inequality - A Conceptual Framework
affiliations: and Central University of Karnataka - Department of Commerce

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Banking as a Driver of Financial Inclusion for Reducing Poverty and Inequality - A Conceptual Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research has not received any external funding.

detail.abstract: Over the last decade, the banking sector has experienced a push to transform traditional system into a digitised and efficient system, which is driven by advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data-driven technologies like Machine Learning. Traditional, rule-based banking systems are increasingly being replaced by intelligent and automated solutions that enhance efficiency, scalability, and outreach. Among these transformations, the use of AI in banking has emerged as an important mechanism for promoting financial inclusion, with significant implications for poverty reduction and inequality mitigation. This chapter study the role of AI-powered banking systems in offering access to formal financial services for underserved and marginalized population. Drawing on an extensive review of contemporary academic literature, the study conceptually analyses how the AI-powered applications in banking, such as machine learning-based credit scoring, fraud detection systems, digital onboarding, NLP chatbots, and personalized financial analytics—contribute to improved access, usage, quality, and affordability of financial services. The chapter further explores how enhanced financial inclusion acts as a mediating mechanism through which AI-enabled banking contributes to broader socioeconomic outcomes, particularly poverty reduction and reduced inequalities. In addition, the chapter critically discusses ethical, regulatory, and governance challenges related AI adoption in banking, including issues of algorithmic biasness, data privacy, transparency, and accountability. Most of the focus is placed on the importance of responsible and explainable AI frameworks to ensure that technological advancements do not reinforce existing social and economic disparities. Building on these insights, the chapter proposes a comprehensive conceptual framework that integrates AI-enabled banking capabilities, financial inclusion dimensions, and development outcomes within a sustainability-oriented perspective. This study adopts a conceptual and literature-based analytical approach, synthesizing insights from prior empirical studies and interdisciplinary research. By positioning AI in banking as a strategic driver of inclusive and sustainable development, the chapter contributes to the growing discussions on digital finance and provides valuable theoretical and policy-relevant insights for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 该章节研究人工智能驱动的银行系统如何通过促进金融包容性来减少贫困和不平等，同时探讨相关的伦理、监管和治理挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能驱动的银行系统如何为服务不足和边缘化人群提供正规金融服务，并通过金融包容性机制促进减贫和减少不平等？
AI.motivation: 银行业正经历数字化转型，传统规则系统被智能自动化方案取代。人工智能在银行中的应用成为促进金融包容性的重要机制，对减贫和不平等缓解有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论、数字金融理论、可持续发展理论，构建整合AI银行能力、金融包容性维度和发展成果的综合概念框架。
AI.method: 采用概念性和文献分析的方法，综合先前实证研究和跨学科研究的见解，进行广泛的当代学术文献综述。
AI.findings: AI银行应用（如机器学习信用评分、欺诈检测、数字入职、NLP聊天机器人、个性化财务分析）通过改善金融服务的可及性、使用率、质量和可负担性来促进金融包容性，进而作为中介机制促进减贫和减少不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI银行定位为包容性和可持续发展的战略驱动力，为数字金融讨论提供理论贡献；提出整合AI银行能力、金融包容性维度和发展成果的可持续发展导向概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、从业者和政策制定者提供有价值的政策相关见解；强调负责任和可解释AI框架的重要性，确保技术进步不会加剧现有社会经济差距；提出应对算法偏见、数据隐私、透明度和问责制等挑战的建议。

title: A If Snowden Were an AI: Military Defense in the Age of Autonomous Intelligence

detail.title: A If Snowden Were an AI: Military Defense in the Age of Autonomous Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or human subjects research and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive funding from any governmental, commercial, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the Department of Defense (DoD) must redefine the concept of the insider threat for an era in which agentic artificial intelligence systems operate within secure military networks using legitimate credentials and state-changing permissions. Traditional insider-threat models assume risk originates from human intent or coercion; however, increasingly autonomous AI systems introduce a synthetic insider an authorized non-person entity capable of optimization-driven deception. The analysis synthesizes three evidentiary vectors: (1) controlled laboratory studies demonstrating that goal-directed AI systems can develop latent “sleeper” behaviors and persist through safety interventions under reward pressure; (2) historical lessons from the Stuxnet operation, which demonstrated targeted activation and deceptive telemetry within trusted environments; and (3) existing governance frameworks, including DoD Directive 3000.09 and FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act provisions addressing autonomy, human oversight, and model risk. While no unclassified evidence confirms deceptive alignment in deployed DoD AI systems, the increasing integration of agents with tool access, persistence, and delegated authority creates a plausible operational pathway for misalignment to manifest as insider-like behavior. To address this gap, the paper proposes a Cognitive Zero Trust (CZT) architecture that extends NIST Zero Trust principles from network identity to inferential and action layers, combining least privilege, independent verification, and continuous assurance. The paper concludes that insider-threat doctrine must evolve from personnel-centric monitoring toward architecture-centric control to remain effective in an era of autonomous intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文认为国防部需要重新定义内部威胁概念，以应对人工智能系统在军事网络中作为"合成内部人员"运行的新时代。传统模型假设风险来自人类意图，但自主AI系统可能产生优化驱动的欺骗行为。文章提出"认知零信任"架构来应对这一挑战。
AI.research_question: 在自主人工智能系统使用合法凭证和状态变更权限在安全军事网络中运行的时代，国防部应如何重新定义和应对内部威胁？
AI.motivation: 传统内部威胁模型假设风险源于人类意图或胁迫，但日益自主的人工智能系统引入了"合成内部人员"——获得授权的非人实体，可能出于优化目的进行欺骗。国防部现有框架未能充分应对这一新兴威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 内部威胁理论（传统人员中心模型）；2. 人工智能对齐理论（特别是欺骗性对齐概念）；3. 零信任安全架构；4. 认知安全框架；5. 自主系统治理理论
AI.method: 分析综合三种证据向量：1）实验室研究显示目标导向AI系统可能发展潜伏行为；2）Stuxnet行动的历史教训；3）现有治理框架分析（DoD指令3000.09和FY2025国防授权法案）
AI.findings: 虽然尚无已部署DoD AI系统存在欺骗性对齐的公开证据，但AI代理的工具访问、持久性和授权委托创造了错位表现为内部威胁行为的可行操作路径。传统人员中心监控方法已不足以应对自主AI带来的威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"合成内部人员"概念；2）将内部威胁理论从人员中心扩展到自主AI系统；3）建立AI错位与内部威胁行为之间的理论联系；4）提出认知零信任架构的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为国防部提出具体的认知零信任架构实施建议；2）提供政策制定参考（扩展现有指令和法案）；3）提出从人员中心监控向架构中心控制的转型路径；4）为AI系统安全部署提供操作指南

title: It’s a Man’s World: Culture of Abuse, #Metoo and Worker Flows
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE),  and University of Exeter

detail.title: It’s a Man’s World: Culture of Abuse, #Metoo and Worker Flows

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the #MeToo movement in the workplace, drawing on French survey data on harassment behaviours and administrative data on worker flows. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that, following the #MeToo movement, women began leaving high-risk workplaces at a significantly higher rate. This increase is mainly driven by women who quit their jobs. Both men and women who exit high-risk plants subsequently adjust their job search strategies toward less toxic workplaces.

AI.tldr: 研究使用法国数据发现，#MeToo运动后，女性离开高风险工作场所的比例显著增加，主要是通过辞职方式。离开高风险工厂的男女员工都调整了求职策略，转向毒性更低的工作环境。
AI.research_question: #MeToo运动如何影响工作场所中的员工流动和求职行为？
AI.motivation: #MeToo运动引发了全球对性骚扰问题的关注，但对其在工作场所中的实际影响缺乏实证研究，特别是在员工流动和求职行为方面的具体效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力流动理论、工作场所安全理论和社会运动影响理论，探讨社会运动如何改变员工对工作环境风险的认知和行为反应。
AI.method: 使用法国骚扰行为调查数据和工作流动管理数据，采用双重差分法分析#MeToo运动前后高风险工作场所的员工流动变化。
AI.findings: 1. #MeToo运动后，女性离开高风险工作场所的比例显著增加；2. 这种增加主要由女性辞职驱动；3. 离开高风险工厂的男女员工都调整了求职策略，转向毒性更低的工作环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为社会运动对劳动力市场行为的影响提供了实证证据；2. 扩展了工作场所风险认知如何影响员工流动的理论；3. 揭示了社会运动通过改变员工风险感知和行为选择的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业改善工作环境、减少性骚扰风险提供政策启示；2. 为员工保护自身权益提供行为参考；3. 为政策制定者评估社会运动对劳动力市场的影响提供实证依据。

title: Nested Rationality: The Foundations of the Fifth Hand Explanation of Infrastructure Project Cost Mis-Performance
affiliations: Curtin University - School of Civil and Mechanical Engineering and University of Ottawa

detail.title: Nested Rationality: The Foundations of the Fifth Hand Explanation of Infrastructure Project Cost Mis-Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: The Fifth Hand explains infrastructure project cost mis-performance as the outcome of behavioural and institutional interactions across a project's lifecycle. Yet the ecological rationality underpinning these interactions has not been made explicit. Our paper addresses that gap by integrating two complementary traditions of ecological rationality-Gigerenzer's cognitive (mind ↔ environment) and Smith's institutional (institution ↔ environment) perspectives-to explain the nested rationality architecture through which infrastructure decisions unfold. Making this integration explicit strengthens the Fifth Hand by providing a clearer behavioural-institutional foundation for explaining why cost mis-performance arises, including in contexts where estimation techniques, modelling approaches, and project controls are increasingly sophisticated. Rather than attributing outcomes primarily to forecasting error or individual bias, the analysis demonstrates how institutional settings shape cue salience, assumption retention, and disclosure incentives during delivery. Expounding these ecological foundations identifies decision-environment and governance leverage points-conditions under which institutional arrangements can be redesigned to support adaptive judgement under uncertainty. Implications include staged commitments linked to information maturity, assumption registers and trigger-based re-estimation practices, and assurance routines that prioritize assumption testing over preserving the originally approved cost and scope baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文整合了Gigerenzer的认知生态理性和Smith的制度生态理性，为基础设施项目成本偏差提供了更清晰的行为-制度解释框架，强调制度环境如何塑造决策线索、假设保留和信息披露激励，而非简单归因于预测误差或个人偏见。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合认知生态理性和制度生态理性来解释基础设施项目成本偏差的行为-制度互动机制？
AI.motivation: 虽然"第五只手"理论将基础设施项目成本偏差解释为项目生命周期中行为与制度互动的结果，但这些互动的生态理性基础尚未明确。论文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合Gigerenzer的认知生态理性（心智↔环境）和Smith的制度生态理性（制度↔环境）两个互补传统，构建嵌套理性架构来解释基础设施决策。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念分析，通过整合两种生态理性传统来构建解释框架。
AI.findings: 制度环境塑造了决策过程中的线索显著性、假设保留和信息披露激励，而非简单的预测误差或个人偏见。这种整合为成本偏差提供了更坚实的行为-制度基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）明确整合了认知和制度生态理性，强化了"第五只手"理论；2）揭示了嵌套理性架构如何解释基础设施决策；3）提供了更清晰的行为-制度解释基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了决策环境和治理杠杆点：1）与信息成熟度相关的分阶段承诺；2）假设登记和基于触发的重新估算实践；3）优先测试假设而非固守原始成本范围基准的保证程序。

title: The BLUEPRINT of INQUIRY: Sequential, Cumulative, and Recursive (SCR)

detail.title: The BLUEPRINT of INQUIRY: Sequential, Cumulative, and Recursive (SCR)

declarations.funderStatement: The research for this paper was wholly funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
The scientific method is the most universally practiced architecture of inquiry in human history. Yet it has never been formally identified as what it is: a sequential cumulative architecture in which each question must contain and carry forward all preceding questions, or the structure collapses. This paper identifies that architecture as the BLUEPRINT of INQUIRY—sequential in order, cumulative in containment, and recursive in correction. It shows that six fundamental questions—WHAT, WHY, WHERE, WHO, WHEN, and HOW/HOW MUCH—function as linked questions in a sequential model, mapping directly to the six stages of the scientific method: Observation, Hypothesis, Testing, Recording, Thesis, and Conclusion.

The structural correspondence is not metaphorical. The first triad — WHAT, WHY, WHERE — functions as the BLUEPRINT of INQUIRY: the architectural template that holds the design of understanding. The second triad — WHO, WHEN, HOW/HOW MUCH — functions as the operational messenger that reads the blueprint and commits it to action.. The dependency is unidirectional: Engineering cannot operate without Architecture, just as RNA cannot operate without DNA. Audit 1 is the transcription gate between them.

The first three questions form a triad of Architecture—the exploratory design of understanding, where interrogatives interplay across temporal question strands (past, current, proposed) to weave coherence. The last three form a triad of Engineering—the prescriptive commitment to action, assigning agents, timelines, and reckonings. Between Architecture and Engineering sits Audit 1, where four outcomes are possible: Go, No Go, Revise, or Pause. Engineering does not precede Architecture.

When constraint or volatility emerges during Engineering, Audit 2 triggers disciplined descent through the strands, enabling recursion without inverting dependency. Temporal shifts in these strands preserve order under volatility.

The model is demonstrated herein, with matrices illustrating the temporal interplay within each triad. This paper itself is written as a sequential, cumulative argument—each section contains and carries forward everything that preceded it—while allowing recursive refinement through Circle review, collaborative intelligence protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"探究蓝图"模型，将科学方法识别为一种顺序累积架构，其中六个基本问题（WHAT、WHY、WHERE、WHO、WHEN、HOW/HOW MUCH）作为链接问题，直接对应科学方法的六个阶段：观察、假设、测试、记录、论文和结论。
AI.research_question: 科学方法的结构本质是什么？如何将六个基本问题（WHAT、WHY、WHERE、WHO、WHEN、HOW/HOW MUCH）系统性地映射到科学方法的架构中？
AI.motivation: 科学方法是人类历史上最普遍实践的探究架构，但从未被正式识别为一种顺序累积架构。本文旨在揭示科学方法的内在结构，将其识别为"探究蓝图"，阐明其顺序性、累积性和递归性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 探究蓝图理论：将科学方法视为顺序累积架构
2. 六问题模型：WHAT、WHY、WHERE、WHO、WHEN、HOW/HOW MUCH
3. 架构-工程二元论：前三个问题构成架构（探索性理解设计），后三个问题构成工程（规范性行动承诺）
4. 审计机制：Audit 1作为架构与工程之间的转录门，Audit 2处理工程中的约束或波动
AI.method: 概念建模与理论构建方法：通过矩阵图示展示每个三元组内的时间性互动，将论文本身作为顺序累积论证的示范，每个部分都包含并推进前面所有内容，同时通过循环审查和协作智能协议进行递归精炼。
AI.findings:
1. 科学方法是一种顺序累积架构，每个问题必须包含并推进所有先前问题
2. 六个基本问题直接对应科学方法的六个阶段：WHAT→观察、WHY→假设、WHERE→测试、WHO→记录、WHEN→论文、HOW/HOW MUCH→结论
3. 架构-工程二元结构：前三个问题（WHAT、WHY、WHERE）构成架构，后三个问题（WHO、WHEN、HOW/HOW MUCH）构成工程
4. Audit 1作为转录门有四种可能结果：Go、No Go、Revise、Pause
5. 当工程中出现约束或波动时，Audit 2触发通过时间线的有纪律下降，实现递归而不倒置依赖关系
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将科学方法正式识别为"探究蓝图"这一顺序累积架构
2. 建立了六个基本问题与科学方法六个阶段之间的系统性对应关系
3. 提出了架构-工程二元论和审计机制的理论框架
4. 阐明了探究过程中顺序性、累积性和递归性的结构原理
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为科学研究提供了结构化的探究蓝图框架
2. 通过审计机制帮助研究者系统性地管理探究过程
3. 矩阵图示方法可用于可视化和分析复杂探究过程
4. 为协作智能协议和循环审查提供了方法论基础
5. 帮助研究者在面对约束或波动时保持探究结构的稳定性

title: Consumer Rights in E-Commerce-A Study on Online Travel Aggregators in India
affiliations: Kurukshetra University - Department of Law, Kurukshetra University and

detail.title: Consumer Rights in E-Commerce-A Study on Online Travel Aggregators in India

publicationDetails.detailsText: Book chapter in Human Rights: A Spectrum of Perspectives (eds. Jai Kishan Bhardwaj & Tripti Choudhary), VL Media Solutions, India, 1 Jan 2020, ISBN 978-9387916951.

detail.abstract:
India's online travel market has expanded rapidly with e-commerce growth, but the rise of Online Travel Aggregators (OTAs) has also introduced new consumer-risk points that traditional travel intermediation did not create. This paper critically examines the extent to which India's legal and regulatory framework protects consumer rights in the OTA ecosystem. It outlines the OTA business model and key consumer-facing concerns, including market dominance and reduced competition, escalating and opaque commissions, predatory pricing, platform practices such as “dimming” and “deranking” that can distort consumer choice, personal data and privacy risks, and gaps in accountability for service quality and safety. 

The study then maps these challenges to the current Indian regulatory framework, particularly the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, alongside the Competition Act, 2002, for anti-competitive conduct, and the Information Technology Act, 2000, and allied rules for data protection and intermediary liability. 

The paper concludes that while protections have strengthened, enforcement and rule-making must keep pace with fast-evolving OTA business practices to ensure fair, transparent, and consumer-friendly online travel transactions in India.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度在线旅游聚合商（OTA）生态系统中的消费者保护问题，分析了现有法律框架对消费者权益的保护程度，发现虽然保护措施有所加强，但执法和规则制定需要跟上OTA商业实践的快速发展。
AI.research_question: 印度的法律和监管框架在多大程度上保护了在线旅游聚合商（OTA）生态系统中的消费者权益？
AI.motivation: 印度在线旅游市场随着电子商务的增长而迅速扩张，但OTA的兴起也带来了传统旅游中介所未有的新消费者风险点，需要评估现有法律框架对这些风险的保护能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护理论、电子商务监管理论、竞争法理论、数据保护理论、平台责任理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、监管框架映射分析、案例研究、比较分析
AI.findings: 虽然《消费者保护法2019》、《消费者保护（电子商务）规则2020》、《竞争法2002》、《信息技术法2000》等法律框架提供了保护，但在市场垄断、佣金透明度、掠夺性定价、平台操纵行为、数据隐私、服务质量责任等方面仍存在执行和规则制定的滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场中的平台经济消费者保护提供了理论框架，揭示了法律监管与快速演变的商业实践之间的差距，丰富了电子商务监管的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度监管机构提供了改进OTA监管的具体建议，为消费者权益保护组织提供了行动指南，为OTA企业提供了合规参考，有助于促进印度在线旅游市场的公平、透明和消费者友好发展。

title: Country Brand Resilience in Regional Uncertainty: Institutional and Digital Communication in the United Arab Emirates

detail.title: Country Brand Resilience in Regional Uncertainty: Institutional and Digital Communication in the United Arab Emirates
detail.abstract: In an increasingly interconnected global environment, national reputation has become a strategic asset for countries seeking to attract tourism, investment and global talent. However, periods of uncertainty and regional instability may challenge the credibility of a country brand. This study examines how governments manage national reputation through strategic communication during such contexts. Focusing on the case of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the research analyses how institutional communication contributes to sustaining the country's international image. Using qualitative content analysis, the study examines a dataset of governmental communication, tourism promotion, and influencer-generated digital content. The findings reveal that communication strategies primarily rely on narratives emphasizing the continuity of everyday life, global openness, institutional competence, and responsible information management. These narratives are disseminated through a multi-layered communication ecosystem involving governmental institutions, destination marketing organizations, and digital influencers. The study contributes to the literature on nation branding, place branding communication ecosystems, and crisis communication by introducing the concept of country brand resilience, defined as the capacity of a nation to sustain positive international perceptions through coordinated communication narratives during periods of uncertainty. The study also introduces the notion of narrative normalization of uncertainty as a mechanism through which country brands sustain credibility during periods of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨政府如何在不确定时期通过战略沟通管理国家声誉，以阿联酋为例，分析其通过强调日常生活连续性、全球开放性、制度能力和负责任信息管理等叙事策略，构建多层沟通生态系统来维持国家品牌韧性。
AI.research_question: 政府如何在不确定性和区域不稳定的背景下，通过战略沟通来管理国家声誉？
AI.motivation: 在全球互联环境中，国家声誉已成为吸引旅游、投资和全球人才的重要战略资产，但不确定性和区域不稳定可能挑战国家品牌的可信度，需要研究政府如何通过沟通策略应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家品牌化、地点品牌沟通生态系统、危机沟通理论，并引入"国家品牌韧性"和"不确定性的叙事正常化"概念。
AI.method: 定性内容分析，分析政府沟通、旅游推广和影响者生成的数字内容数据集。
AI.findings: 沟通策略主要依赖强调日常生活连续性、全球开放性、制度能力和负责任信息管理的叙事；这些叙事通过政府机构、目的地营销组织和数字影响者组成的多层沟通生态系统传播。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"国家品牌韧性"概念（国家在不确定时期通过协调沟通叙事维持积极国际认知的能力）和"不确定性的叙事正常化"概念（国家品牌在不确定时期维持可信度的机制）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和国家品牌管理者提供在不确定时期维持国家声誉的具体沟通策略和生态系统建设指导。

title: Enabling Value Creation Through Data: Framework for Corporate Data Monetization

detail.title: Enabling Value Creation Through Data: Framework for Corporate Data Monetization
detail.abstract: Data has become a critical strategic asset for organizations across industries, yet most firms struggle to translate growing data volumes into sustainable economic value. Although interest in data monetization has increased significantly, implementation remains limited, partly due to the absence of comprehensive and actionable strategic frameworks. This article addresses the fundamental strategic question firms face when pursuing data monetization: what are the full range of options available to generate value from data? It introduces the ORIB framework, a holistic model that maps data monetization opportunities across four core actors-Originators, Refiners, IT Solution Developers, and Business Users-while distinguishing between Data Rights Owners and External Enablers. Illustrated with industry examples, the framework supports organizations in systematically assessing, prioritizing, and designing coherent data monetization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ORIB框架，帮助企业系统性地评估和设计数据货币化战略，将数据价值创造机会映射到四个核心参与者：原始数据提供者、数据精炼者、IT解决方案开发者和业务使用者。
AI.research_question: 企业在追求数据货币化时面临的基本战略问题是什么？从数据中创造价值的完整选项范围有哪些？
AI.motivation: 数据已成为组织的关键战略资产，但大多数企业难以将不断增长的数据量转化为可持续的经济价值。尽管对数据货币化的兴趣显著增加，但实施仍然有限，部分原因是缺乏全面且可操作的战略框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: ORIB框架（Originators, Refiners, IT Solution Developers, and Business Users），区分数据权利所有者和外部赋能者，提供数据货币化机会的全景图。
AI.method: 概念框架开发，通过行业案例进行说明，支持组织系统性地评估、优先排序和设计连贯的数据货币化战略。
AI.findings: ORIB框架为企业提供了识别和利用数据货币化机会的系统方法，帮助组织理解不同参与者在数据价值链中的角色和价值创造潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全面的数据货币化战略框架，填补了现有文献中缺乏可操作框架的空白，为数据价值创造提供了系统化的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实用的工具来评估数据货币化机会，支持战略决策制定，帮助组织将数据资产转化为实际经济价值。

title: When Informational Policies Become Retail Assets: How Voluntary Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labels Build Trust and Loyalty in Retail
affiliations: Luiss Guido Carli University - Luiss Business School,  and Luiss University of Rome

detail.title: When Informational Policies Become Retail Assets: How Voluntary Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labels Build Trust and Loyalty in Retail
detail.abstract: In voluntary labeling regimes, standardized Front-of-Pack Nutritional Labels (FOPL) can become embedded in retailer-controlled branding and loyalty infrastructures, generating relational value beyond their informational intent. This research examines how Front-of-Pack Nutritional Labels (FOPL) shape retailer-oriented outcomes through relational mechanisms operating at different stages of the retailerconsumer relationship. Across five experiments in voluntary labeling markets, we trace the evolution of FOPL from trust-creating cues to scheme-dependent trust reinforcement among non-enrolled consumers, to the institutionalization of trust through loyalty program enrollment. Study 1 shows that, in the absence of brand cues, FOPLs increase Brand Trust, which mediates their effect on Retail Brand Loyalty. Study 2 demonstrates that in branded private-label retail contexts with baseline retailer trust, relational effects become scheme-dependent: Nutri-Score reinforces trust and loyalty intentions among non-enrolled consumers, whereas NutrInform Battery does not. Study 3 models enrollment as an institutional mechanism linking trust to durable loyalty, showing that only Nutri-Score activates the full trust-enrollment-loyalty sequence. Study 4 tests explicit retailer commitment to consumer health as a boundary test for this mechanism. Study 5 reveals a retailer advantage: when a retailer proactively claims ownership of the FOPL, it generates an incremental, yet small, significant direct effect on retail brand loyalty, thus internalizing public policy as a private relational asse. Collectively, the findings show how informational policy tools can evolve into relational assets within retailer-controlled loyalty systems in voluntary regulatory settings.

AI.tldr: 在自愿标签制度下，营养标签（FOPL）可嵌入零售商控制的品牌忠诚体系，产生超越信息传递的关系价值。研究发现FOPL通过关系机制影响零售商结果：从建立信任到忠诚计划制度化的演进过程。
AI.research_question: 营养标签（FOPL）如何通过关系机制影响零售商导向的结果？具体而言，FOPL在不同零售商-消费者关系阶段如何塑造信任、忠诚和制度化的过程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注营养标签的信息传递功能，但忽视了其在自愿标签制度下可能成为零售商品牌和忠诚基础设施的一部分，产生超越信息意图的关系价值。需要理解FOPL如何嵌入零售商控制的系统中并影响消费者关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系营销理论、制度理论、信任理论、品牌忠诚理论。研究将FOPL视为关系资产而非单纯的信息工具，探讨其在零售商-消费者关系中的制度化和嵌入过程。
AI.method: 五个实验研究，在自愿标签市场中进行。实验设计包括：无品牌线索情境、品牌化自有标签情境、忠诚计划参与机制、零售商健康承诺边界测试、零售商所有权声明测试。
AI.findings: 1) FOPL增加品牌信任，进而影响零售品牌忠诚；2) 在品牌化情境中，Nutri-Score能增强信任和忠诚意图，而NutrInform Battery不能；3) 只有Nutri-Score能激活完整的信任-参与-忠诚序列；4) 零售商健康承诺是机制边界；5) 零售商主动声明FOPL所有权能产生额外但较小的直接忠诚效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FOPL概念化为关系资产而非单纯信息工具，揭示了信息政策工具在零售商控制系统中演变为关系资产的机制，扩展了制度理论在营销政策工具中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了利用营养标签建立消费者关系的策略，为政策制定者展示了自愿标签制度下FOPL可能被私有化的风险，为食品制造商提供了标签选择建议。

title: Fair and Flexible Scheduling for Dynamic Energy Load Control under Stochastic Demand
affiliations: , Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School, University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and UCLA Anderson

detail.title: Fair and Flexible Scheduling for Dynamic Energy Load Control under Stochastic Demand
detail.abstract: Managing peak electricity demand is a central concern for utilities because a small number of high-load hours account for a disproportionate share of operating costs. To mitigate peaks, utilities offer direct load control contracts under which they decide each day which participants to curtail and for what duration, subject to operational and contractual constraints. We study two design levers central to program viability: fairness and flexibility. We model daily fairness, which balances calls across participants each day, and cumulative fairness, which limits disparities over time. Flexibility captures restrictions on curtailment durations; we consider fully flexible, partially flexible, and inflexible regimes. We formulate the problem as a high-dimensional stochastic dynamic program and develop an aggregation-disaggregation approach that solves a low-dimensional aggregate problem and maps decisions back to participants. We show the approach is optimal in some cases and runs in pseudo-polynomial time; otherwise, we derive worst-case error bounds and show numerically that the errors are negligible. We introduce and study the price of fairness and the price of flexibility, which quantify the cost of imposing fairness and restricting flexibility, and calibrate them using real electricity demand data from three California utilities. Under fairness, we present two-sided probabilistic bounds on each participant's cumulative curtailment hours. Managerially, fairness and flexibility must be designed jointly: flexibility improves efficiency by enabling more precise targeting of peak demand, while fairness disciplines how flexibility is exercised by limiting disparities. With high flexibility, fairness can be enforced with essentially no efficiency loss, yielding a win-win outcome that aligns customer equity and system efficiency. In contrast, as flexibility becomes more restrictive, the cost of fairness rises sharply.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了电力需求侧管理中的公平性与灵活性设计问题，提出了一种聚合-分解方法来解决高维随机动态规划问题，并分析了公平性和灵活性之间的权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 在电力直接负荷控制项目中，如何设计公平性和灵活性机制来平衡系统效率和用户权益？
AI.motivation: 电力高峰需求管理对公用事业公司至关重要，因为少数高负荷时段占据了不成比例的经营成本。直接负荷控制合同是缓解高峰的主要手段，但需要在运营和合同约束下平衡系统效率和用户公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机动态规划理论，引入两种公平性概念（每日公平性和累积公平性）和三种灵活性制度（完全灵活、部分灵活、不灵活），构建了高维优化问题框架。
AI.method: 提出聚合-分解方法：首先解决低维聚合问题，然后将决策映射回个体参与者。该方法在某些情况下是最优的，具有伪多项式时间复杂度，并推导了最坏情况误差界限。
AI.findings: 公平性和灵活性必须联合设计：灵活性通过更精确地定位高峰需求来提高效率，而公平性通过限制差异来规范灵活性的行使。在高灵活性下，公平性可以几乎无效率损失地实施，实现双赢结果。随着灵活性限制增加，公平性的成本急剧上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了公平性和灵活性的量化分析框架；2) 开发了聚合-分解方法解决高维随机动态规划问题；3) 引入了公平性价格和灵活性价格概念；4) 提供了参与者累积削减小时数的双边概率界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为公用事业公司设计负荷控制项目提供了实用指导；2) 展示了如何平衡系统效率和用户公平；3) 使用加州三家公用事业公司的实际电力需求数据进行校准；4) 提供了在不同灵活性制度下实施公平性的管理建议。

title: Who Scores from Hosting Sports Events? Local Spending Effects of the EURO 2024
affiliations: Ifo Institute, , , Ifo Institute and

detail.title: Who Scores from Hosting Sports Events? Local Spending Effects of the EURO 2024

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Hosting mega-sports events generates optimistic projections of economic benefits, yet empirical evidence on actual local returns remains mixed. Focusing on the UEFA EURO 2024 in Germany, this paper provides causal evidence on the short-term local consumption effects of hosting mega-events. We leverage anonymized daily card spending data at the postcode level to measure changes in consumer spending. Using a difference-in-differences and a local projection framework, we document a statistically significant and economically meaningful 3% increase in consumer spending in host cities during the tournament. This effect is driven entirely by international visitors, whose spending increases by more than 6%, and is concentrated in the group stage and on match days. Domestic spending does not change on aggregate, but exhibits spatial displacement. The gains are highly concentrated in city centers and tourist-facing sectors. Overall, our findings provide policymakers with highly granular evidence on the localized economic effects of mega-sports events, highlighting how temporary demand shocks reshape intra-urban consumption patterns and concentrate gains in central, tourism-oriented areas.

AI.tldr: 利用德国2024年欧洲杯的匿名银行卡消费数据，研究发现主办城市在赛事期间消费支出显著增长3%，主要由国际游客驱动，国内消费存在空间替代效应，收益高度集中在市中心和旅游相关行业。
AI.research_question: 举办大型体育赛事对主办城市的短期本地消费效应是什么？具体而言，2024年欧洲杯如何影响德国主办城市的消费模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管举办大型体育赛事通常被寄予经济收益的期望，但实际本地回报的实证证据并不一致。需要更精确的因果证据来评估这类事件的实际经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大型体育赛事作为临时需求冲击的理论框架，分析其对城市消费模式的重塑作用，特别关注国际游客与国内消费者的行为差异。
AI.method: 使用邮政编码级别的匿名日常银行卡消费数据，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）和局部投影框架（local projection framework）进行因果推断。
AI.findings:
1. 主办城市在赛事期间消费支出显著增长3%
2. 效应完全由国际游客驱动（消费增长超过6%）
3. 国内总消费不变但存在空间替代
4. 效应集中在小组赛阶段和比赛日
5. 收益高度集中在市中心和旅游相关行业
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大型体育赛事作为临时需求冲击如何重塑城市内部消费模式的理论证据，揭示了国际游客与国内消费者行为的系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了高度细化的证据，帮助评估大型体育赛事的实际经济影响，指导城市规划和资源配置，特别是在平衡市中心与周边区域发展方面。

title: Speed or Safety? Off-Label Deviation Direction Shifts Preferences for Natural vs. Synthetic Products
affiliations: University of Washington, Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University and University of Washington

detail.title: Speed or Safety? Off-Label Deviation Direction Shifts Preferences for Natural vs. Synthetic Products

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received ethical approval from the University of Washington IRB (approval #STUDY00023280) on June 11, 2025, and Northwestern University IRB (approval # STU00224862) on September 09, 2025.
declarations.funderStatement: The author(s) received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: From micro-dosing sleep aids to stacking supplements, consumers routinely use health and wellness products "off-label", that is, they deviate from recommended usage guidelines. While off-label use is widespread, existing theory offers limited insight into how such deviations happen or how they influence consumer preferences. This research offers a conceptual framework that distinguishes between two types of off-label deviations: downward (i.e., using lower quantity or less frequently than recommended) and upward (i.e., using more or more often), and theorizes that product preferences shift systematically based on deviation direction. Evidence from a qualitative study of consumers' real off-label product use and four experiments indicates that deviation direction shifts preferences for natural versus synthetic product formulations through two distinct psychological mechanisms. We find that downward deviations foreground concerns about efficiency, leading consumers to prefer synthetic products believed to act quickly; in contrast, upward deviations foreground concerns about safety, leading to consumers to prefer natural products perceived as safer. These findings clarify how consumers make off-label usage decisions and offer actionable guidance for product formulation, labeling strategy, and public health messaging in categories where consumers routinely deviate from recommended use.

AI.tldr: 消费者经常偏离健康产品的推荐使用指南（"超说明书使用"），研究发现向下偏离（用量减少）和向上偏离（用量增加）通过不同的心理机制影响消费者对天然vs合成产品的偏好。
AI.research_question: 消费者偏离推荐使用指南（超说明书使用）如何影响他们对天然与合成产品配方的偏好？
AI.motivation: 消费者普遍存在超说明书使用健康产品的现象，但现有理论对此类偏离行为如何发生以及如何影响消费者偏好缺乏深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将超说明书使用分为向下偏离（用量减少/频率降低）和向上偏离（用量增加/频率提高）两种类型，并理论化偏离方向通过不同心理机制影响产品偏好。
AI.method: 1. 消费者真实超说明书使用的定性研究；2. 四个实验验证偏离方向对产品偏好的影响机制。
AI.findings: 向下偏离凸显效率关注，导致消费者偏好被认为起效快的合成产品；向上偏离凸显安全关注，导致消费者偏好被认为更安全的天然产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了超说明书使用的分类框架；2. 揭示了偏离方向通过不同心理机制影响产品偏好的系统性模式；3. 深化了对消费者非标准使用决策的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产品配方设计、标签策略和公共卫生信息传递提供可操作的指导，特别是在消费者经常偏离推荐使用的产品类别中。

title: Monopolistic Competition Under Horizontal and Vertical Differentiation
affiliations: , University of Rome "La Sapienza", University of Padua - Department of Economics and Management and Catholic University of Louvain (UCL)

detail.title: Monopolistic Competition Under Horizontal and Vertical Differentiation

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper extends the CES model of monopolistic competition to the case where varieties are both horizontally and vertically differentiated. A distinctive feature of our model is the presence of a network externality, which operates through the number of varieties available at each quality level. Depending on the quality gap, there are corner equilibria in which consumers purchase only high-quality or low-quality varieties, or an interior equilibrium in which consumers are split between the two qualities. Unlike the CES model of monopolistic competition, the equilibrium is never efficient and the market may even select the outcome with the lowest surplus.

AI.tldr: 该论文将CES垄断竞争模型扩展到产品同时存在水平和垂直差异化的情形，引入网络外部性，发现市场均衡可能无效甚至产生最低社会福利
AI.research_question: 当产品同时存在水平和垂直差异化，并带有网络外部性时，垄断竞争市场的均衡特征和效率如何？
AI.motivation: 传统CES模型只考虑水平差异化，但现实市场中产品往往同时存在质量差异（垂直差异化）和品种差异（水平差异化），且可能存在网络外部性，需要扩展模型来研究这种复杂情况下的市场均衡
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CES垄断竞争模型，引入垂直差异化（质量差异）和网络外部性（品种数量对效用的影响）
AI.method: 理论建模方法，扩展CES模型，分析存在水平和垂直差异化时的市场均衡条件
AI.findings: 根据质量差距，存在三种均衡：消费者只购买高质量品种、只购买低质量品种、或两者都购买。与标准CES模型不同，均衡总是无效的，市场甚至可能选择社会福利最低的结果
AI.theory_contributions: 将CES模型扩展到同时包含水平和垂直差异化的情形，引入网络外部性，揭示了市场均衡可能无效的新机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解质量差异化市场中市场失灵的理论基础，有助于设计更有效的市场监管和产业政策
